subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 14=7 The freedom fighters are the (a) _______ (hero) sons of our land. They fought to save our (b) _______ (gold) Bangla in 1971. We have got the (c) _______ (independent) of our loving motherland by their (d) _______ (super) sacrifice. Some of the (e) _______ (free) fighters are still (f) _______ (live). Most of the freedom (g) _______ (fight) are now (h) _______ (actual) above 70 years old. (i) _______ (deed), we are very (j) _______ (luck) to see them (k) _______ (direct). As they are our heroic sons, we should respect them (1) _______ (profound). We must remember them (m) _______ (ever). Because they laid down their lives (n) _______ (keep) all behind.
guide_solution: (a) heroic (b) golden (c) independence (d) superior (e) freedom (f) alive (g) fighters (h) actually (i) Indeed (j) lucky (k) directly (1) profoundly (m) forever (n) keeping
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Mymensingh Board-2023 (Board Question With Solution)
